oe_cel_dec_yuan_kurultai = {
	decision_category = government_decisions
	hide_repeatable_tag = yes
	potential = {
		is_rebel_country = no
		oe_cel_is_yuan_track = yes
		NOT = { has_variable = oe_cel_dec_yuan_kurultai_done }
	}
	allow = {
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = oe_cel_two_fiefs_tt
			any_subject = {
				OR = {
					is_subject_type = oe_cel_fanwang
					is_subject_type = oe_yw_touxia
				}
				count >= 2
			}
		}
		gold >= 100
	}
	ai_will_do = {
		value = 0
		if = {
			limit = {
				oe_cel_ai_enabled = yes
				gold >= 200
				oe_cel_revocation_heat_value >= 1
			}
			value = 45
		}
	}
	illustration_tags = { 10 = exterior }
	option = {
		name = oe_cel_dec_yuan_kurultai.a
		ai_chance = {
			value = 100
		}
		effect = {
			set_variable = { name = oe_cel_dec_yuan_kurultai_done value = 1 }
			add_gold = -100
			change_celestial_authority = { value = celestial_authority_weak_penalty }
			oe_cel_cool_revocation_tension = { amount = 2 }
			every_subject = {
				limit = {
					OR = {
						is_subject_type = oe_cel_fanwang
						is_subject_type = oe_yw_touxia
					}
				}
				add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_cel_kurultai_accord_mod years = 20 mode = replace }
			}
		}
	}
}

oe_cel_dec_alt_mandate = {
	decision_category = government_decisions
	hide_repeatable_tag = yes
	potential = {
		is_rebel_country = no
		oe_cel_is_celestial_emperor = yes
		NOT = { has_variable = oe_cel_dec_alt_mandate_done }
		OR = {
			oe_cel_is_sinosphere_alt_track = yes
			oe_cel_is_foreign_conqueror_track = yes
		}
	}
	allow = {
		stability >= 0
	}
	ai_will_do = {
		value = 0
		if = {
			limit = { oe_cel_ai_enabled = yes }
			value = 45
		}
	}
	illustration_tags = { 10 = exterior }
	option = {
		name = oe_cel_dec_alt_mandate.a
		ai_chance = {
			value = 25
			if = {
				limit = { oe_cel_is_sinosphere_alt_track = yes }
				value = 75
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { oe_cel_is_foreign_conqueror_track = yes }
				value = 15
			}
		}
		effect = {
			set_variable = { name = oe_cel_dec_alt_mandate_done value = 1 }
			add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_cel_full_sinicization_mod years = 30 mode = replace }
			set_variable = { name = oe_cel_mandate_path value = 1 }
		}
	}
	option = {
		name = oe_cel_dec_alt_mandate.b
		ai_chance = {
			value = 25
			if = {
				limit = { oe_cel_is_foreign_conqueror_track = yes }
				value = 85
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { oe_cel_is_sinosphere_alt_track = yes }
				value = 25
			}
		}
		effect = {
			set_variable = { name = oe_cel_dec_alt_mandate_done value = 1 }
			add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_cel_dual_sovereign_mod years = 30 mode = replace }
			set_variable = { name = oe_cel_mandate_path value = 2 }
			if = {
				limit = { OR = { tag = BYZ tag = ROM } }
				set_variable = { name = oe_cel_twin_phoenix_ready value = 1 }
			}
		}
	}
}
